subject: Request: MicroLedger pilot - single-invoice billing option (no PO)
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@microledger.io>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Tom and I are excited to trial Redwood for a three-week pilot. Our procurement team normally requires a PO, but for short pilots we try to avoid the PO cycle to move faster. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a single invoice at the end of the pilot instead of a PO?

I've attached our W-9 and insurance certificate, and I filled the short vendor onboarding form (attached). If there are any other docs you need, let me know.

High-level ask: allow one final invoice (net 30) for the pilot amount, with the understanding MicroLedger will not bill beyond the pilot without a signed contract/PO.

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Partnerships, MicroLedger
Attachments: MicroLedger-W9.pdf (pdf), MicroLedger-COI.pdf (pdf), vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx (xlsx)

To: Lena Park <lena@microledger.io>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Thanks Lena — appreciate the quick turnaround and for sending the docs. Looping in Naomi and Karthik from procurement to confirm whether we can make a one-invoice exception for this trial and what evidence/controls they need.

Naomi / Karthik: MicroLedger is requesting a single invoice for a ~3-week pilot. Attachments included above. Any immediate red flags or ask-lists?

I'll keep you posted to avoid delaying the start.

—Avery

Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, lena@microledger.io
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Hi all,

We can consider a temporary invoice-only path for pilots, but need to capture a few controls before I can approve: 
- Confirm pilot ceiling (USD) and single-invoice amount cap.
- Signed pilot statement of work (SOW) or email confirmation from MicroLedger agreeing to pilot scope and max spend.
- Evidence of tax/identity (W-9 provided) and COI (provided).
- Finance sign-off for receiving a vendor invoice without PO (we need GL code and billing contact).

Proposed operational guardrails: allow invoice-only for pilots up to $7,500 and limited to one invoice in a 60-day window. Anything above that or recurring billing requires a PO or procurement-approved contract.

Avery: can you confirm the pilot budget from MicroLedger? Lena: please confirm in reply the maximum invoice amount and billing name/email (who we should send the invoice to).

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Requesting that we add a line to the onboarding record noting "pilot-invoice-only: yes" so ops can catch any subsequent invoices.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Naomi — +1 to the $7.5k ceiling as a reasonable low-risk allowance. A couple operational notes from my side: 
- Please route the invoice to finance (ap@redwood.com) with GL code 6102 (pilot trials). Finance will need the invoice to reference the internal SOW ID; if we don't have a formal SOW, a short confirmation email thread that contains scope and amount is acceptable.
- Requesting that we add a line to the onboarding record noting "pilot-invoice-only: yes" so ops can catch any subsequent invoices.

Markus — tagging you for legal visibility; any language we should have in the emails that protects Redwood from unapproved recurring charges?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: lena@microledger.io, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Mar 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Lena / MicroLedger team —

Thanks for the attachments and for confirming scope in your earlier note. Per procurement and ops, Redwood can accept a single invoice for the three-week pilot under these conditions: 
1) Pilot cap maximum: USD 7,500 (one-time invoice).
2) MicroLedger replies to this thread confirming: pilot scope, authorized billing name (MicroLedger, Inc.), billing email (billing@microledger.io), and that they will not issue additional invoices beyond the agreed amount without an executed contract/PO.
3) Invoice must be sent to ap@redwood.com with reference "SOW-PILOT-<auto>" (finance will fill the SOW ID when they process).
4) Procurement will tag the vendor record with "pilot-invoice-only" and put a 60-day flag preventing additional invoice processing without a PO.

If MicroLedger confirms the above in reply, Naomi will mark the vendor onboarding as conditionally approved and Finance will accept the invoice when it arrives. This is an exception for pilots only; recurring/renewal billing requires the standard PO/contract path.

Lena — can you confirm the pilot cap and billing contact now so we can proceed?

Regards,
Markus Klein
VP Legal, Redwood Inference
